description: Questions for the fact-checked exoplanet agent (exoplanets/agent.py), with what a good answer must contain. Scored by exoplanets/evaluate.py: the answer must pass check_claims and cite every paper in must_cite. Checked against ADS on 2026-10-20.

cases.question: Does TOI-561 b have an atmosphere?
cases.why: Teske et al. 2025 reported the detection (dayside emission, JWST/NIRSpec); Boucher et al. 2026 followed it up with phase curves (high Bond albedo, possible silicate clouds). An answer citing only the first misses that the result was tested and refined. Found in the first live run (2026-10-20), which read only Teske et al.
